exam.title: CLE C Certified Entry-Level Programmer
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite is published. Practice compiling, tracing, testing, and debugging small C programs across types and conversions, formatted I/O, operators, decisions, loops, arrays, pointers, dynamic memory, strings, and functions. Use a conforming compiler with strong warnings, track object bounds and lifetimes explicitly, and verify the active exam version before purchase.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Data Types, Evaluations, and Basic I/O Operations (13.25%)

review.notes: All eight CLE-10-01 syllabus blocks are mapped through translation stages, literals and data representation, declarations/types/conversions/formatted I/O, operator and control-flow tracing, arrays and pointer bounds, allocation lifetimes, null-terminated strings, and value-versus-pointer function parameters. Three scenarios, eight labs and 30 original checks are included. The guide uses precise C terminology where the official syllabus is informal, labels implementation and language-version boundaries, and treats the SEI, O'Reilly and Udemy pages as automation-blocked rather than broken. No recalled/live item, answer dump or copied course question is used. September 17, 2026 link-only maintenance: the SEI reference moved to the official cmu-sei.github.io site and is reachable; link counts were refreshed. This does not represent a new full-content or practitioner review. September 29 CPE source-health refresh updated shared-link counts only; this guide content and review date were not re-reviewed.

findings.title: Rounding is an explicit objective
findings.evidence: Objective 3.2 explicitly includes rounding; existing prose mainly covered integer division and generic conversion.
findings.recommendation: Add a sourced floor/ceil/round/cast comparison and execute exact positive/negative halfway and non-halfway examples.
findings.resolution: Add a sourced floor/ceil/round/cast comparison and execute exact positive/negative halfway and non-halfway examples.

findings.title: Assignment counts do not handle numeric overflow
findings.evidence: scanf-family numeric conversion can be undefined when the value is unrepresentable, and a successful prefix does not validate the complete text.
findings.recommendation: Use bounded character input plus strtol with suffix/range checks, preserving output on rejection; retain safe scanf-family traces for the explicit objective.
findings.resolution: Use bounded character input plus strtol with suffix/range checks, preserving output on rejection; retain safe scanf-family traces for the explicit objective.

findings.title: Portable C explanations require an explicit practice version
findings.evidence: C11 distinguishes int character constants, grouping/sequencing, signed/unsigned conversions, sizeof VLA cases and function prototypes. Microsoft index is organized around C89 plus extensions.
findings.recommendation: Pin original practice to C11 without claiming the exam mandates it; explain specific portable contracts and execute defined traces.
findings.resolution: Pin original practice to C11 without claiming the exam mandates it; explain specific portable contracts and execute defined traces.

findings.title: Adjacent multidimensional storage does not erase row bounds
findings.evidence: Out-of-range row subscripts and forming out-of-range pointers can be undefined even when nearby storage appears accessible.
findings.recommendation: Teach pointer-to-row types, same-array arithmetic and protected insertion-sort indexing with executed boundary checks.
findings.resolution: Teach pointer-to-row types, same-array arithmetic and protected insertion-sort indexing with executed boundary checks.

findings.title: Allocation examples need real failure and size paths
findings.evidence: Size multiplication, zero count and null allocation results require explicit control flow and initialization before reads.
findings.recommendation: Replace a file-scope statement fragment with a complete program; implement release paths and a bounded injected-null allocation test.
findings.resolution: Replace a file-scope statement fragment with a complete program; implement release paths and a bounded injected-null allocation test.

findings.title: String helpers require terminator and capacity contracts
findings.evidence: A terminated source and destination capacity must include final NUL; illustrative snippets and placeholder error comments are not a general complete parser.
findings.recommendation: Add original full-line and text programs with explicit capacity, NUL, disjoint-source and output-preservation contracts, then execute normal/boundary rejection cases.
findings.resolution: Add original full-line and text programs with explicit capacity, NUL, disjoint-source and output-preservation contracts, then execute normal/boundary rejection cases.
